title: Brick stables behind 2011 and 2017 Prairie
items: The stable behind 2011 Prairie now stands on the alley as a two-storey brick building 14.6 m deep, filling its lot from line to line with a fire wall at each end, as the 1911 fire-insurance map draws it, and with the one window the map marks on its alley wall.

The stable behind 2017 Prairie, the longest on this alley at 15.2 m along it, now stands with two carriage doors, a fire wall on its north lot line, the window the map marks, and a paved yard and walk back to the house.
